summary: We've developed an interactive and educational visual novel named "To the Stars and Beyond," in which players will be able to create their own character and manage living with a team of astronauts and experts on a mission to begin colonizing and studying Mars. Players will be able to go around a map and do certain challenges, which teach valuable information about how astronauts live in space, while also showing leadership and basic space concepts. Currently, it is a tutorial in which players will just have to complete 8 challenges, but futurely we are looking forward to creating a full-blown story with personalized art in which your choices will affect your future positions at the NASA station.
details: It is an educative visual novel coded on Ren'Py that teaches leadership and the lives of astronauts in space, meant to be captivating for younger generations. It is easy to play and accessible for all ages. This project is intended to educate people on what they should know about space missions. Our project is creative due to its unique story and way of teaching things. Our team considered multiple factors like where it should be coded and how the storyline should develop and be easy to maintain.
